Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Wheat Bread}}
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Recipe Book|TotK}}{{Cite|{{Big|Wheat Bread}}
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Wheat Breads by [[Cooking]] [[Tabantha Wheat]] and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. Eating them will restore some of Link's [[Heart]]s. The scent of these soft, springy breads is known to be heavenly. Adding extra [[Ingredient]]s to Wheat Bread can result in the following variations: * '''Hearty Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Wheat Bread}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. If eaten, they heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Energizing Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Wheat Bread}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using energizing Ingredients. Consuming them will partially refill Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Enduring Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Wheat Bread}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using enduring Ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely restored and overfilled when he eats these breads. * '''Hasty Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Wheat Bread}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using hasty Ingredients. When eaten, Link will receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Spicy Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Wheat Bread}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using spicy Ingredients. They can be eaten to grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Wheat Bread}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using electric Ingredients. One level of [[Shock Resistance]] will be given to Link when he eats them. * '''Mighty Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Wheat Bread}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using mighty Ingredients. By eating these breads, Link's attack power will be boosted. * '''Tough Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Wheat Bread}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using tough Ingredients. If consumed, they increase Link's defensive abilities. * '''Sneaky Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Wheat Bread}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using sneaky Ingredients. Link's [[Stealth]] will receive a boost if he eats them. * '''Chilly Wheat Bread''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Wheat Bread}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
Made with wheat from the Tabantha region, this soft, springy bread smells just heavenly.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using chilly Ingredients. Eating these breads will grant Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== Like in {{BotW}}, [[Link]] can make Wheat Bread by combining and bundle of [[Tabantha Wheat]] and [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. By default, the [[Recipe]] will only restore two [[Heart]]s, but this can be increased by adding extra Ingredients. On top of the variations found in {{BotW|-}}, Wheat Bread can also come in a Rapid, Bright, Warding, Sticky, Scorching, Sunny, and Biting variants depending on the Ingredients used. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Wheat Bread is earned by completing the [[Quest]] "[[Expert Cooking Lesson]]". It is made using five bundles of [[Tabantha Wheat]] and pieces of [[Rock Salt]]. However, it can be lowered to four of each Ingredient through the completion of "[[Hungry Hunches]]". When prepared before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]], the [[Cooking]] effects of other [[Food]]s will increase by 20%. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Wheat Bread Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for Wheat Bread ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Breads, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
